biggest_catch: The $100 credits land only after the new customer has been active for 90 straight days — and if either of you misses a payment in that window, the reward is gone.
catches: Both credits are applied only after the new customer has been with Breezeline for 3 months (90 consecutive days), within 1-2 billing cycles after that
During the 90-day period both parties must pay all invoices in full when due
Friend must not have subscribed to any Breezeline service within 120 days before the referral date
Friend must sign up for a qualifying residential service (Internet, Video, or Voice) and keep it active 90 consecutive days
One referral code per referred customer; unlimited referral bonuses for the referrer
